 Lakers vs Clippers Prediction, Picks & Best Bet for Tonight's NBA Game
 Tom Oldfield 
 • Betting Analyst 
 22+ years betting experience 
 Updated: 
Oct 28, 2026 , 02:05 PM ET
 • 4 min read 
 The Lakers' offense is rolling through four games, and more backcourt magic is their ticket to a win over the Clippers tonight.
 Jump to section: 
 Prediction 
 Combo 
 Player Props 
 Odds 
 nba
 Oct 28 • 7:30 PM ET 
 Photo By - Reuters Connect. 
 The Los Angeles Lakers’ unbeaten start is over, but they’re 4.5-point favorites to start a new streak tonight against the depleted Los Angeles Clippers. 
 Though Luka Doncic & Co. are on the second night of a back-to-back set, their offense has made a scorching start to the season, and my Lakers vs. Clippers predictions signal one-way traffic at Intuit Dome. 
 Take a closer look at this Wednesday, Oct. 28 matchup with my free  NBA picks and betting angles ahead of a 10:30 pm ET tip-off.
  TOP PICK 
Lakers vs Clippers prediction: Lakers -4.5
 This pick rides a Los Angeles Lakers offense that’s already firing on all cylinders while shooting a league-best 55% from the field, and I’m playing this up to -5.5 and 53% . 
 The Lakers are averaging 128.3 PPG (second-most), and Walker Kessler has been a seamless fit as a roller and lob threat. 
 In contrast, the Los Angeles Clippers aren’t built for track meets, and Rui Hachimura joins a lengthy injury report here, leaving the hosts with fewer options to guard Luka Doncic . 
 The Lakers were 39-25 ATS last season when Doncic suited up , and they bagged a 125-117 win over the Clippers last week, despite Luka’s 11 turnovers. 
 Their Big 3 combined for 73 points that night on 28-for-48 shooting, and I don’t see Ty Lue’s men keeping up when the visitors hit that offensive gear. 
 COVERS INTEL: With a lack of steady ball-handlers, the Clippers are coughing up 22.7 turnovers per game so far this year — easily the worst mark in the NBA — and those giveaways will just fuel a Lakers team that’s shooting 81% in the paint. 
 Enjoying Covers content? Add us as a preferred source on your Google account Lakers vs Clippers combo
 The Lakers are 7-3 SU in the past 10 meetings between these teams, and I’m counting on their backcourt duo to provide the spark tonight against their cross-city rivals. 
 Austin Reaves is thriving as the clear No.2 option, with  26.5 PPG on 63% shooting , and he shredded the Clippers last week on the way to a 10-for-13 stat line. With Doncic drawing a crowd, Reaves is also making his triples at a 57% clip. 
 I’ll round out my combo with the Over on Luka’s assists. His scoring grabs the headlines, but Doncic has dished 19 dimes across his last two outings , and the Clippers may have to lean on double teams if Derrick Jones Jr. gets into foul trouble. 
 A big assists night is no stretch when the visitors have scored 125+ points in every game so far this year. 
 Lakers vs Clippers combo
 Lakers moneyline
 Austin Reaves Over 22.5 points
 Luka Doncic Over 7.5 assists
 Lakers vs Clippers player props
 Lakers player prop: Sandro Mamukelashvili Over 7.5 points
 Sandro Mamukelashvili has been a productive bench contributor through the first week of the season (22.8 MPG), and his numbers should climb as he logs more court time with these Lakers guards.
 Mamu has gone past this O/U number in his last two games , including a 17-point effort last night, and his willingness to let it fly from beyond the arc (5-for-9 so far) is part of the formula for punishing the Clippers' overhelp on Doncic here.
 Clippers player prop: Darius Garland Over 25.5 points
 Darius Garland is walking into all the shots he wants this season. As the Clippers' most dynamic scoring threat by some distance, he's off to a fast start with 18.3 FGA per game , and I'd back this to 56%.
 Garland is also the type of crafty point guard who can give the Lakers fits, preying on the defensive flaws of a Doncic-Reaves backcourt . He poured in 26 points against JJ Redick's men last week, and his consistent jump shooting will be vital for a team missing Hachimura, Brandon Ingram, and Max Strus.
